Subject: Request: subcontractor attestation + proposed order-form redline

Hi Lauren / Kimberly,

Thanks for the run-through last week. Following our internal review, CloudWave needs two items to close the PO: a short attestation list for downstream subprocessors and a mutually agreeable Order Form redline (scheduling & billing unchanged). We've attached a proposed redline for the Order Form and a small attestation matrix with the current subprocessor roster.

High-level asks: 
- Can Redwood confirm acceptance of the attestation matrix (see attached) or provide missing evidence for any listed subprocessor within 5 business days?
- We propose the following flow-down tweak to Section 6.2 (subcontracting): give CloudWave right to approve subvendors that process Payment Data. Redwood to provide an approval timeline (we suggested 10 business days).

Attachments (stubs): orderform_redline_v1.docx (Word redline) | attestation_matrix.csv (CSV)

We'd like to get this locked prior to DocuSign routing — target EOD next Thursday if possible. Happy to do a 20-min call to triage.

Thanks,
Anna Morales

CloudWave Solutions

Anna / Lauren —

Thanks for the materials. I'm looping in the legal review notes below to make the path forward clear.

1) Attestation matrix: please include the subprocessor purpose and location columns (we need to validate cross-border processing risk). If CloudWave can add the SOC2/SOC3/HIPAA attestation links for each subprocessor, that will speed our review.

2) Proposed flow-down to Section 6.2: we will accept a right-to-approve for Payment Data subprocessors with the following constraints: (a) approval limited to well-documented security concerns, (b) Redwood has the right to remediate/replace the subvendor if reasonable, and (c) approval decision to be provided within 7 business days (we can accept 7, reduced from 10). I'll draft a one-sentence redline to insert into the Order Form.

3) Evidence / timing: if a CloudWave subprocessor lacks a public attestation, we will request a short compensating control statement or a receipt of audit evidence. Provide all evidence links via Drive or as attachments.

Attachments (stub): subproc_attestation_template.xlsx — please populate and return.
